svg.text: ✗ Bad: different rows, same bank → serialized
(bank 0 is asked twice → 2-way). The whole warp waits for the slowest bank.
✓ Good: each thread hits a different bank → no conflict
32 threads × 4 B = 128 B, without extra bank-conflict passes.
Highlighted = the word each of the warp's 32 threads asks for.
